D = "/home/user/club-media"

logo = Image.open(os.path.join(D, logo_name)).convert("RGB")
pad = 24
box_w, box_h = W // 2 - pad * 2, ch - pad * 2
sc = min(box_w / logo.width, box_h / logo.height)
lw, lh = int(logo.width * sc), int(logo.height * sc)
canvas.paste(logo.resize((lw, lh), Image.LANCZOS), ((W // 2 - lw) // 2, TOP + (ch - lh) // 2))

# Photo RIGHT, cover-crop
photo = Image.open(os.path.join(D, photo_name)).convert("RGB")
pw, ph = W // 2, ch
sc = max(pw / photo.width, ph / photo.height)
nw, nh = int(photo.width * sc), int(photo.height * sc)
pr = photo.resize((nw, nh), Image.LANCZOS)
l, t = (nw - pw) // 2, (nh - ph) // 2
canvas.paste(pr.crop((l, t, l + pw, t + ph)), (W // 2, TOP))

draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
draw.line([(W // 2, TOP), (W // 2, H)], fill=(205, 210, 220), width=2)
out = os.path.join(D, "banner.png")

# greeting text on the right

try:

rx0 = bx + sz + 30; rxw = W - rx0 - 20
bb = draw.textbbox((0,0), txt, font=font)
tw, th = bb[2]-bb[0], bb[3]-bb[1]
rx = rx0 + (rxw - tw)//2
ry = (H - th)//2 - bb[1]
draw.text((rx, ry), txt, font=font, fill='white')
